 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    key = (lambda r, c: c-r) if use_difference else (lambda r, c: r+c)

            residue_colors[k] = residue_colors[nearest]

    return [[residue_colors[key(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(h)]
